fusions.name: Mesh Cast
fusions.desc: Throws a mesh over the ground around you, dealing 10 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaving each [Pinned] for 2 seconds. Your afflictions on a target spread to every enemy within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Haul Under
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health. Strikes a target up to 7 tiles away for 20 damage, rising to 1.5 times that from full range, and leaves it [Soaked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Snagged Return
fusions.desc: For 10 seconds, each affliction put on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to whoever cast it.

fusions.name: Trailing Weed
fusions.desc: Each time you strike, a strand of weed snags the nearest enemy within 4 tiles, deals 5 damage and slows it by 20% for 2 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.
